items.heading: Change a price, a phone number or a page yourself. Today.
items.body: Rates, staff, offers, hours and locations are content, not code. Your team changes them in a form and they're live in under a minute. No developer, no ticket, no two-week wait.
bullets: Location data held once, published to every page
Every edit to a live page is recorded, with who made it
Migrations keep every URL, so you don't lose your rankings on moving day
items.caption: The page editor: title, description and search settings in plain fields.

items.heading: A page for every place you serve.
items.body: A buyer searches by town, by zip, by service. A site with one "areas we serve" paragraph can't rank for any of them. We build the pages, from the data you already have, and keep them consistent.
bullets: Inbox Portable Storage: 343 town pages and 272 zip pages, generated from one list
White & White: nineteen city pages and twenty-two service pages across two counties
Mule Box: three cities, three phone numbers, one place to edit it all
items.caption: Inbox Portable Storage: a page for every town and zip code they deliver to.

items.heading: Read on a phone, at a red light, and still gets the call.
items.body: Most of your visitors are holding a phone. The site loads fast, the form fits the screen, the number is one tap, and every submission and call is counted so you know which page earned it.
bullets: Kalamazoo Mortgage: pre-approval form on the first screen, straight to the loan team
FoxBox: a quote path for moving and one for storage, each with its own follow-up
Every form protected from spam and tied to a conversion

data.heading: What we look at before we say a word about a redesign.
data.body: We read your live site the way a search engine and a buyer do. You get the findings in plain English, ranked, whether you hire us or not.

items.title: Forms that leak
items.body: Every form submitted and followed: does it reach a person, does the customer get a confirmation, is it counted.

items.title: Speed on a phone
items.body: How the site loads on the device most of your visitors are holding, and what is slowing it down.

items.title: Calls you can't see
items.body: Whether phone calls from the site are tracked at all, or whether your best leads are invisible in the reports.

items.title: Pages losing people
items.body: Where visitors land and leave, and which pages have no clear next step.

items.title: Structure for search
items.body: Titles, descriptions, one page per service and per market, and the pages search engines have nothing to work with.

items.title: What we'd fix first
items.body: A short, ranked list of changes worth making this month, whoever makes them.
